title: Final Fantasy XVI
insight: Final Fantasy 16 is the series’ first full-fledged action-RPG, fully doing away with the classic turn-based battle system it has long been known for and takes FF15’s action-combat to a whole-new level of complexity and depth. With Devil May Cry(DMC) combat director Ryota Suzuki on board, FF16 is the most modern evolution of stylish combo-driven combat that made the DMC series so popular.

title: Final Fantasy X
insight: Final Fantasy X, released in 2001, is widely considered one of the best games in the renowned Final Fantasy series. With its captivating story, lovable characters, and innovative gameplay mechanics, FFX sets the bar high for other role-playing games. In this article, we’ll dive into the reasons why Final Fantasy X stands out as the best in the series. Final Fantasy X introduces the Conditional Turn-Based Battle (CTB) system, which revolutionized turn-based combat. The system allows for real-time strategic decisions, making battles feel more dynamic and immersive. The Active Time Battle (ATB) system also makes a return, adding an element of speed and reaction time to combat.

title: Halo 3
insight: Halo 3, released in 2007, built upon the success of its predecessors and played a crucial role in popularizing online multiplayer gaming on consoles. With the introduction of Xbox Live, players could connect and compete globally, setting a standard for future multiplayer experiences. The game's success demonstrated the viability of online gaming, leading to a surge in multiplayer-focused titles across various genres, including shooters and action-adventure games.
review: One of the most influential multiplayer shooters ever created.

title: Lies of P
insight: Lies of P is a thrilling soulslike that takes the story of Pinocchio, turns it on its head, and sets it against the darkly elegant backdrop of the Belle Epoque era. You are a puppet created by Geppetto who’s caught in a web of lies with unimaginable monsters and untrustworthy figures standing between you and the events that have befallen the world of Lies of P. You are awakened by a mysterious voice that guides you through the plagued city of Krat - a once lively place that has been poisoned by madness and bloodlust. In our soulslike, you must adapt yourself and your weapons to face untold horrors, untangle the unfathomable secrets of the city's elites and choose whether to confront predicaments with the truth or weave lies to overcome them on the journey to find yourself.
